answer: The shale ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own tundra record, and its own share of the zenith quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 1123 identities would post 4129 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
